W.note: Counts 5-7-5 (Moth-er-of-pearl cloud / pink green gold then on-ly grey / my breath still rising); colour sequence fading to grey is true to nacreous clouds and the breath turn lands, though mother-of-pearl is stock.

X.note: Counts 4-7-5 (Na-cre-ous glow is 4), so the first line is short; 'sky holds its breath' is a stock phrase and the images are thin.

Y.note: Counts 5-7-5 (fire on frozen air is 5 if fire is one syllable); 'slow fire on frozen air' is a strong image, but the lines run together with no cut and nacreous plus mother-of-pearl is a bit redundant.

Z.note: Counts a clean 5-7-5 (Pearl cloud af-ter dusk / the pink lets go of its edge / one watch-er then grey); the colour letting go of its edge is fresh and the lone watcher gives it a turn.
